tagline: You're in a strange house. Click to look. Find the way out.
description:
You wake in a room you do not know. The plant is too small. There is a note on the desk. The corridor goes further than it should.

This is a short point-and-click walking-sim. Click a thing to walk over and look at it. Click a door to try it. Picked-up things sit in the tray at the edge of the screen — open the tray and use them on the world.

The picture you are in, and what you are carrying, stay in this copy of the app. Close it, come back, and you are still in that corridor.

On a phone it is the same tap. Drag the room if the view is larger than the screen. Mute is the speaker in the corner. Reset starts from the first room.

An unofficial port of The House by Artur Kot. The rooms, art, and sounds are his. This copy keeps your progress in the file.
